docs.title: Active Night Peeling
docs.subtitle:
This peeling skin care gently but effectively stimulates the skin’s natural exfoliating process overnight thanks to a caviar lemon extract microdosed in fruit acid in an original combination of vegetable oils, wax and butter. From the moment you wake up, your skin is softer. Night after night, the skin’s texture is refined, and the complexion is fresh and radiant.

BENEFITS:

“New skin” effect

Reduced skin irregularities

Even and radiant complexion

docs.title: Lait-Crème Sensitive - Fragrance free
docs.subtitle:
The Lait-Crème Sensitive shares the same moisturizing and nourishing properties in a new formulation developed for sensitive skin. It remains rich in essential fatty acids and vitamins, which provide the skin with essential nutrients, retain water, and protect it from aggressions.

It leaves a comfortable, soothing, and silky-soft veil over even the most fragile, sensitive, and reactive skin, such as babies.

BENEFITS:

Moisturized skin regains suppleness and elasticity

Plumped, smooth, and soft skin

Consistently soothes hypersensitive skin

Reduces skin sensitivity

Provides an immediate feeling of comfort

RESULTS:

Nourishes face and body skin and reduces signs of dryness – 89%*

Face and body skin are immediately and durably moisturized – 87%*

The product calms/soothes feelings of discomfort, tightness, skin irritation and redness – 88%**

The product protects the skin from external aggressions – 84%*

Skin regains its suppleness and elasticity – 94%**

The product calms and soothes my baby's/child's fragile skin – 100%***

*Self-evaluation, 100% sensitive skin, 28 days of use on 38 people, under dermatological control.

**Self-evaluation, 100% sensitive skin, 28 days of use on 34 people, dermatologically monitored.

***Self-evaluation, 100% sensitive skin, 28 days of use on 20 babies, under pediatric control.
